rv.q: Broom Play is a refreshing reminder that absurdity has never gone out of style.
The whole evening's experience is a flash back to a time when New York City theater was continuously raw, challenging, and stretching boundaries to find new ways to tell a story.
The XYZ Theatricals presentation of Broom Play is a phenomenal experience.

cn.t: Critics largely embrace this absurdist tragicomedy, praising its Beckett-inspired rhythms and tight direction. One outlier finds it uneven, but the intimate staging and physical performances earn strong marks overall.
